title: One subject per pattern
description: Each pattern covers one problem, one rule or one decision, with a title you could search for.
root_cause: A pattern that mixes subjects cannot be found, cannot be trusted and cannot be retired cleanly.
diagnosis_steps: Ask: if this subject changes, can I update this pattern alone? If not, split it.
quick_fix: Keep the title short and specific, put the exact error text in error_signature, and tag it.
root_fix: Prefer enriching an existing pattern over creating a near duplicate.
